title: TOEIC Listening & Reading Full Test 12
description: Đề thi đầy đủ theo cấu trúc đề TOEIC Listening & Reading của IIG Việt Nam: 200 câu, 120 phút (Listening ~45 phút audio chạy liên tục, Reading 75 phút). Chủ đề: sửa điện thoại, bản tin nội bộ, cửa hàng xe đạp, phỏng vấn tuyển dụng, kiến trúc thư viện, thuê xe tải, xe đạp công cộng, trang trại nghỉ dưỡng, xe buýt điện, lớp gốm, vườn cộng đồng, trường nhạc, tai nghe; đủ dạng hội thoại 3 người, câu hỏi hàm ý, biểu đồ, chèn câu, đoạn kép và ba đoạn. Mỗi câu có giải thích tiếng Việt.

groups.transcript: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Old Town walking tour. My name is Jonas, and I'll be your guide for the next two hours. We'll begin here at the clock tower, which was built in 1820 and is the oldest structure in the city. From here, we'll walk down Market Street to see some of the city's original merchant houses. MILLBROOK (January 22) – After 45 years of repairing shoes on Oak Street, Frank Rossi is retiring. – [1] – His shop, Cobbler's Corner, will be taken over by Emma Hart, who has worked alongside him for the past six years.

Ms. Hart plans to keep the shop's name and its traditional repair services, but she will also add new ones, such as leather bag repair and custom shoe stretching. – [2] – She also intends to launch a Web site so that customers can check the status of their repairs online.

"Frank taught me everything," said Ms. Hart. "I want to continue the quality work that customers expect." – [3] –

Mr. Rossi said he plans to spend more time with his grandchildren and to travel. – [4] – The shop will be closed from February 1 to 7 for minor renovations.
